title: Eklipse Finance (Kaia) — zombie Saddle-style StableSwap: meta-pool prices the depegged base LP at par; permissionless LP-dump drains all 10,403.96 pUSD

closed_reasons: Base pool 0x4F5d9F3b swap rates are market-efficient: 1,000 KDAI -> 908.94 oUSDT (in-USD $96.35 vs out-USD $95.52, loss) — no direct swap extraction (fork-verified negative control).

No admin/upgrade path for outsiders: pool owner() is EOA 0x024dfd23bf033d3ae3e9a1e41244ffcb6f6671ea (0 bytes of code), no proxy slots, no migrateTo/setFee reachable, only pause/fee withdrawal are owner-gated.

Junk-token pools p3-p9 are gated by tokens (KSD/KASH/oBUSD/USDK) that DefiLlama does not price and for which no market/exit venue was found — their $2.5k of KDAI/oUSDT/oUSDC/baseLP is not extractable without acquiring those tokens.

Triage figure $80,359.22 is overstated: the DefiLlama adapter's vaults list contains 0x4F5d9F3b twice, and the triage summed owners without de-duplication (double-counted KDAI+oUSDT+oUSDC = ~$31,342).

The meta pool's swap math was validated against calculateSwap (view) and executed via swap() in the fork PoC — the two agree.
Fork block drifts between runs; conclusions reproduced at blocks 229750245, 229753258 and 229754867.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$9,494 net (~$10,407 gross) live from Eklipse Finance on Kaia: the meta pool prices the depegged base LP at par (1.0413) while its real value is $0.1036, so buying ~8-10k KDAI (~$770-960), minting base LP and swapping it in the meta pool drains all 10,403.96 pUSD — fork-verified 5/5; the remaining ~$31.4k is LP-holder-recoverable (H-O), $213 is owner fees (P), and the junk-token pools (~$2.5k) are gated by unmarketable tokens.
